field.name: principle1_title
field.default: Player-first, never paid placement.
field.label: 01 — Title

field.name: principle1_desc
field.default: Affiliate revenue funds the operation, but no operator buys a listing position, a Frank Score, or an FXCheck verdict. The order of offers on this site is the same whether or not a casino runs an active commercial agreement with us.
field.label: 01 — Description

field.name: principle2_title
field.default: We claim every bonus we list.
field.label: 02 — Title

field.name: principle2_desc
field.default: Every offer published goes through a sign-up, claim, and terms-verification cycle. Where possible, a specialist also plays through wagering and attempts a withdrawal — and logs what actually happens, not what the promo page promised.
field.label: 02 — Description

field.name: principle3_title
field.default: Player reports above marketing copy.
field.label: 03 — Title

field.name: principle3_desc
field.default: FXCheck aggregates Yes/No outcomes from real players who claimed the offer. When player data and casino claims diverge, player data wins and the listing is updated within 24 hours.
field.label: 03 — Description

field.name: principle4_title
field.default: Public corrections, signed names.
field.label: 04 — Title

field.name: principle4_desc
field.default: Errors get flagged on the page itself with the date, the correction, and the editor who made it. There are no silent updates. If we changed our mind, we say so.
field.label: 04 — Description

field.label: Show byline policy box
field.description: Declares that bylines are professional pen names of real editors. Every sentence is a factual claim about the desk — keep it literally true.

field.name: bylines_policy_label
field.default: Why our editors write under pen names
field.label: Byline policy — label

field.name: bylines_policy_p1
field.default: The names on this page are professional pen names. Each one belongs to one real person, a member of the FreeExtraChips editorial team or a regular contributor, and to that person only. The gambling industry is small and not always friendly, and our writers keep their private identities out of it.
field.label: Byline policy — paragraph 1

field.name: bylines_policy_p2
field.default: The byline tells you who did the work. Editorial responsibility for everything we publish sits with FreeExtraChips as the publisher. Each profile describes what that editor actually covers and checks. Nothing in these profiles is invented. The portraits are stylised renderings of the editors themselves, not stock images or invented faces.
field.label: Byline policy — paragraph 2

field.name: bylines_policy_p3
field.default: If something we published is wrong, tell us: corrections are made on the page and signed, as described in our correction policy.
field.label: Byline policy — paragraph 3
field.description: Leave empty to drop the paragraph.
